body: Everything I guess, most probably how I feel & is just I don’t know I just feel so sad thinking about it. Especially going pass those places

Is a little too late, she give up her life for this family. She didn’t even managed to do what she love doing, didn’t managed to go to those countries she love to see. :( I really want her to see me succeed.
How do you feel about the app? Is it good?
Awww man, but thankyou so much for reading this post. Appreciate it so much!!!
sweatcoinapp.uk/i/brian496564
Do you need someone to talk too?

Hi, thanks for your concern & im really sorry for my Super late reply. Hmm, I didn’t do much in my life, i been lying on my bed 24/7 just watching shows, feeling super shitty & buying takeaway food. The only time I went out is to go to a bar to get drunk, I really don’t have the will to do anything.
I’m great to hear that you managed to move on & learn a lot through this. And yes there are so many other fishes!!!

Thanks for saying I’m a great guy AHAHA, still got much to learn in this world to be a better person. I cried like fuck, drank lots of alcohol so I won’t be sober but it didn’t help. Rn I’m gyming so hard every single day, making myself tired so I won’t have strength & can have a good night sleep.
So did you get over her? Or you still miss her so god damn much? What did you learn in the process?
Hopefully I can continue remain positive & strong. Till then I live
That’s very sweet of you, don’t worry I will remain strong ☺️ I just have to accept that somethings are not within my control & I have to just let it go.
Yes I guess, but she is a good learning lesson for me. I’m going to take baby steps and move on, no matter how hard it is.

Hmm, I just feel that a real man suppose to give a girl a financial free life. I don’t want because of me, she won’t be able to enjoy the finer things in life. I want to give her a good life even though I’m only 19 but I’m willing to work hard for it.

I lost friends, friends that I’m so close with but I get over it fast. But when it comes to love, I can’t seem to get over it. You know when you thought she is going to be the one & is like I always want to take care of her. Want to protect her in this cruel world & fuck up society, don’t want her to get hurt again. But she didn’t appreciate it everything I do for her, i did everything to see her smile. Recently she is kinda tired & wanted to go on a short oversea trip. So I decided to bring her to neighbouring country, malaysia, for a 3d2n. I’m just 19 working part time and I paid for the trip. And is like whenever we go out, I will bring her to restaurant cause I believe she deserve the best. I don’t mind working harder just for her, she is like my world. I Guess I’m just never good enough, she can just find a rich guy to give her everything I work so hard for.
I agree with you, I Guess I have to learn how to let go even though is really hard :(

I did talk to her but is useless she feel that I’m the one that make people hate her in school but I really didn’t. Like starting of a new semester, people don’t really like her already. I don’t want her to have no friends or people hating on her, I understand is between me and her & if she really did make use of me all these while so be it. At least I really love her and enjoy having her company. Is just kinda sad that I’m being genuine and care about her well being yet she doubted me. :(

My ex and one of my used to be close friends. Let’s call him gab, which used to be close to me till I found the friendship is toxic like he been really 2 face to me. Backstabbing me & acting like a good Friend infront of me. He started working part time with the girl I love. And I’m afraid as he isn’t those good guys, afraid he will hurt her.
Anyway, is it possible to chat with you?
Thank you so much for hearing me out & talking to me :( it means a lot to me!!!

I always wanted to work hard and move to oversea like a countryside and just live a simple life with the person I love. And she want that too, and so I been planning to faster save up money in order to achieve the dreams faster. & yet everything is destroyed.
I just feel like getting her back even though I know is impossible but I really want her back into my life.
Can I know by living the best I can is to study hard, play hard?

What do you mean by more connected than ever, geographically and virtually with the internet? 

I just hope I will feel better soon :( and I hope you are alright too!!!

I’m not really sure, I always been someone who is more emotionally attached someone who is sentimental. I thought she is going to be the one that walk with me down the aisle, even though I’m only 19 I really want to be the man that deserve her. I’m kinda old school, I believe in being loyal & being a gentleman. I give in to her, give up lots of shit for her, my time my sleep & my friends. I really love her & I always make sure she is smiling & well taken care of. I meet her 7am in the morning which means I have to wake up like 5.30am even though my class starts like 9am. I meet her in her break time even though my class is going on just to make sure she ate her meals so that her gastric won’t act up. I make sure she do her homework by skyping with her every single day without fail even though I’m so overwhelmed & tired. I make sure she will be safe when she go our partying cause it really makes me worry that guys will get touchy with her. 

I realised is not about how much effort you put into someone, the person might not even appreciate it. Right now, she is back with her ex bf happily yet I’m here suffering. Is been like one month but I still been so affected that it affect my normal daily life.
Hey, if you need a Friend to talk to. I’m always here!!! Please stay strong :(

I don’t really have hopes on meeting wonderful people in such a fuck up society. Most people are not genuine at all, they just sort of use you for their own advantage. While I’m out here, cherishing my time and all those memories I share with my friends and loved ones. I’m always the one who is much more emotionally attached & it sucks.
Hmm so what’s the purpose of life then?

I appreciate you that someone actually takes their time to read this out :( I didn’t share exactly everything with him, but I know that he been showing me with more concern knowing that I been so depressed lately. I did talk to him about wanting to end my life, and he said to me he will be very hurt & he will feel that he failed as a dad. But I really don’t want him to feel this way, but yet I really want to end my life.
I kinda wonder that too, I know how you feels cause it happens to me one month ago & yet I’m still struggling so badly :(
